collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager shares a little wild honey, spread on a broad leaf.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) shares a little wild honey, spread on a broad leaf. The children lick the leaf until there is nothing left.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) shares a little wild honey, spread on a broad leaf. A bee follows (name1) home, hoping for more.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) shares a little wild honey, spread on a broad leaf. (name1) saves a little for an elder who loves sweets.

e2__fx.name: Ending 2
e2__fx.text: (name1) shares a little wild honey, spread on a broad leaf. It is the sweetest thing anyone has tasted all season.
